solutionSql:
SELECT c.id,
       c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments s
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
    AND s.weight_kg >= 900
)
ORDER BY c.id;

ambiguities.phrase: Find the customers who have booked at least one shipment of 900 kg or more.
ambiguities.readingChosen: Any shipment status counts, including cancelled, because a cancelled shipment was still booked.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only shipments that are not cancelled count, since a cancelled booking is not a real customer booking.

notes: All six shipping customers qualify under the chosen reading, and customers 7 and 8 do not. The sample does not show whether the cancelled rows change the answer, so hidden datasets should test it.
